WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS size_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  g.arcref,
  g.fundflux,
  g.size_per_minute_rate,
  g.size_per_minute_rate - b.average_rate AS excess_over_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.size_per_minute_rate > b.average_rate
ORDER BY excess_over_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10;
